html:
This tour offers a unique opportunity to explore Hoi An’s traditional craft villages, where centuries-old skills are preserved and passed down through generations. Immerse yourself in creativity, culture, and local life, and bring home handmade souvenirs crafted with your own hands.

HIGHLIGHTS

  • Thanh Ha Pottery Village – Over 500 years of history; visit the workshops, try making your own pottery, and take home a unique souvenir

  • Kim Bong Carpentry Village – Witness talented artisans create exquisite wood carvings and feel the vitality in every handmade piece

  • Tra Que Vegetable Village – Experience life as a local farmer, plowing the soil, growing fresh vegetables, and enjoying dishes made from garden-fresh ingredients

  • Hoi An Lantern Village – Learn the art of lantern making, a symbolic craft of Hoi An, and create a meaningful keepsake

ITINERARY

  • Morning: Hotel pick-up by Vietlook Travel guide. Travel to Thanh Ha Pottery Village and Kim Bong Carpentry Village.

  • Late morning: Visit Tra Que Vegetable Village. Experience farming life and taste fresh local dishes.

  • Afternoon: Explore Hoi An Lantern Village and participate in a lantern-making workshop.

  • End of tour: Return to your hotel.

Take the time to visit these traditional craft villages to experience the intersection of past and present, and gain a deeper understanding of Hoi An’s cultural heritage.

TOUR PRICE: USD 32 / person

INCLUSIONS

  • Air-conditioned coach for hotel pick-up and drop-off

  • Professional English-speaking tour guide

  • Entrance fees to all craft villages

  • Hands-on activities: pottery and lantern-making

  • Lunch at a local restaurant (if included)

  • Bottled water

EXCLUSIONS

  • Personal expenses

  • Services not mentioned above

  • Tax
